summary_en: Tokyo Gas authorized acquisition of up to 12 million ordinary shares for a maximum of 50 billion yen through market purchases on the Tokyo Stock Exchange from November 2, 2026 to March 31, 2027, representing 3.6% of issued shares excluding treasury stock. The repurchase supports the company's shareholder return policy centered on progressive dividends linked to long-term earnings per share growth.
title_en: Notice Regarding Determination of Matters Related to Acquisition of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief:
Tokyo Gas announced on October 29, 2026 that its board of directors has resolved to acquire treasury stock under the Company Law Article 156 framework. The acquisition will target up to 12 million ordinary shares with a maximum aggregate purchase price of 50 billion yen, representing 3.6% of issued shares excluding treasury stock held at September 30, 2026 (334,959,259 shares, with 9,530,605 shares in treasury). The repurchase will be executed through market purchases on the Tokyo Stock Exchange between November 2, 2026 and March 31, 2027.

The repurchase is undertaken to support the company's shareholder return policy disclosed on October 29, 2025. The policy positions progressive dividends aligned with long-term earnings per share growth as the core component of shareholder returns. Surplus capital is allocated optimally between growth investment and treasury stock acquisition to support capital control, with the objective of achieving sustained improvement in capital efficiency.
